description: Land Title Settlement Department - Buthpitiya South, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad Map No. 510803
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and cadastral information) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
